# curl — 2006 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 3 curl CVEs of 2006 are in `data/cve/vendors/curl/2006.jsonl`.

### CVE-2006-5731
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2006-11-06 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 2702: Lithium CMS 4.04c - '/classes/index.php' Local File Inclusion (webapps/php, 2006-11-02, verified=1)

Directory traversal vulnerability in classes/index.php in Lithium CMS 4.04c and earlier allows remote attackers to include and execute arbitrary local files via a .. (dot dot) in the siteconf[curl] parameter, as demonstrated by a POST to news/comment.php containing PHP code, which is stored under db/comments/news/ and included by classes/index.php.
